## How to Update

1. Edit SQL queries in `../queries/` directory
2. Run: `sqlc generate`
3. Files in this directory will be automatically updated

## Files in This Directory

- `db.go` - Database connection and Querier interface

- `models.go` - Struct definitions for database tables

All changes to these files will be overwritten on the next `sqlc generate` run.
